items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Chauncey Hanton was playing with Duke, and he went in the Army, and he didn't have a clarinet player, so they got in touch with me and asked me to come. So I went over there and started to playing.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was -- I was working at the Hurricane station. Well, Chauncey Hanton was playing with Duke, and he went in the Army, and he didn't have a clarinet player, so they got in touch with me and asked me to come. So I went over there and started to playing. I played, I guess, the whole stay that he was in Hurricane, I imagine about six or eight weeks or something like that. And --
